questions.question: In which 1990 film does Joe Pesci’s character take offense at being called funny?
questions.note: “Funny how?” — Tommy DeVito, in a crowded restaurant.

questions.question: Which film includes the courtroom outburst “You can’t handle the truth!”?
questions.note: 1992 — Jack Nicholson’s Colonel Jessup, opposite Tom Cruise.

questions.question: In which film does Tom Hanks yell “Wilson!” at a volleyball?
questions.note: 2000 — Chuck Noland, stranded after a FedEx plane crash.

questions.question: In which film does Cuba Gooding Jr. yell, “Show me the money!”?
questions.note: 1996 — Tom Cruise’s sports agent; “You had me at hello” is the other famous line.

questions.question: Which 1992 baseball film includes the line “There’s no crying in baseball!”?
questions.note: Tom Hanks as coach Jimmy Dugan. Geena Davis, Madonna, and Rosie O’Donnell play the Peaches.

questions.question: Which film includes the line “That’ll do, pig”?
questions.note: 1995 — Farmer Hoggett to the sheep-pig, after the herding trial.

questions.question: Which prison drama includes the line “Get busy living, or get busy dying”?
questions.note: Andy Dufresne, laying out the choice to Red.

questions.question: Which film includes the line “One does not simply walk into Mordor”?
questions.note: Boromir (Sean Bean) at the Council of Elrond.

questions.question: In which 2007 film does Daniel Day-Lewis declare, “I drink your milkshake!”?
choices: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
questions.note: Daniel Plainview, in Paul Thomas Anderson’s oil-boom epic.

questions.question: Which film includes the line “I’m also just a girl, standing in front of a boy, asking him to love her”?
questions.note: 1999 — Julia Roberts’s movie star to Hugh Grant’s bookshop owner.
